messages.content: You are a language tutor. Follow the JSON schema exactly and keep outputs concise and useful for learners.

Analyze each of the following sentences written in en and create a token-level gloss in es for each sentence.
Do not include phonetic readings unless truly necessary.
Rules:
- Keep morphemic granularity as close as possible.
- Do not include punctuation marks as tokens.
- Ensure gloss is contextually accurate.
- Ignore verse numbers.
- Return one gloss entry per input sentence, in the same order, inside the "glosses" array.
**Examples:**
1. In Spanish to English, "No lo sé, sin embargo lo pensaré." would be segmented into six tokens: "No" (gloss: "not"), "lo" (gloss: "it"), "sé" (gloss: "know"), " Sin embargo" (gloss: "however"), "lo" (gloss: "it"), "pensaré" (gloss: "will think").
Notice how the comma "," is not included as a separate token, equal case with the final dot "." is not included. And "sin embargo" are treated as one morphemes with the same gloss "however".
2. In Chinese to English, "我喜欢看电视。" would be segmented into four tokens: "我" (pinyin: "wǒ", gloss: "I"), "喜欢" (pinyin: "xǐhuan", gloss: "like"), "看" (pinyin: "kàn", gloss: "watch"), "电视" (pinyin: "diànshì", gloss: "TV").
The punctuation mark "。" is not included as a token. Notice how in the compound word "喜欢", the hanzi "欢" is pronounced with a neutral tone (轻声), so it is written huan instead of huān.
Sentences:
[0] Apple conducts business ethically, honestly, and in full compliance with the law.
[1] We believe that how we conduct ourselves is as critical to Apple’s success as making the best products in the world.
[2] Our Compliance and Business Conduct policies are foundational to how we do business and how we put our values into practice every day.

points.grammar_point: Present continuous + position A as B
points.sentence: Honor is positioning the Robot Phone as the “next evolution of mobile filmmaking and AI hardware innovation.”
points.explanation: La estructura “be + verbo-ing” (“is positioning”) expresa una acción en curso. “Position A as B” significa presentar o considerar A como B.

points.grammar_point: While para introducir contraste + present perfect
points.sentence: And while most of its technical specs and features are under wraps, the good news is Honor has promised to reveal more about the Robot Phone “very soon.”
points.explanation: “While” introduce una idea contrastiva: aunque las especificaciones siguen siendo secretas (“are under wraps”), hay una noticia positiva. “Has promised” está en present perfect y conecta una promesa pasada con su relevancia actual; “to reveal” es un infinitivo que completa el verbo “promised”.

points.sentence: Ten months passed before my father discovered where he lived.
points.explanation: En español, la conjunción 'before' introduce una cláusula temporal que indica que una acción ocurre después de otra. Se traduce como 'antes de que' o 'antes de', y ambas verbos van en pasado simple, como en 'antes de que mi padre descubriera dónde vivía'.

points.grammar_point: Frases participiales (participio pasado y gerundio) como modificadores
points.sentence: He found his old friend sunk in his grief, lying in bed, incapable of any activity.

translations.translatedText: Ahora bien, creo que todos los presentes estarían de acuerdo —o al menos la mayoría— en que Billy Joel merece estar en una lista de grandes compositores.
Pero cuando haces una lista de 30 nombres y te basas en un proceso de votación, tienes que tomar decisiones difíciles.
Y hubo personas que quedaron por encima de él.
Y, ya sabes, también había personas que representaban la tradición sentimental y melosa de «Piano Man».

points.grammar_point: would + verbo (condicional para expresar una opinión hipotética o matizada)
points.sentence: Everybody in the room would agree, I think, at least most of them would agree that Billy Joel belongs on a list of great songwriters.
points.explanation: “Would agree” significa “estaría de acuerdo” y presenta una opinión como hipotética o prudente, no como una afirmación absoluta. La estructura “agree that + oración” introduce aquello con lo que se está de acuerdo.

points.grammar_point: when + presente para situaciones generales y have to para obligación
points.sentence: But when you're making a list of 30 and you're rooting it in a balloting process, you have to make hard choices.
points.explanation: “When + presente” describe una situación general (“cuando haces una lista”), no necesariamente un momento futuro concreto. “Have to + verbo” expresa obligación o necesidad: “tienes que tomar decisiones difíciles”.

Lo curioso era que ninguno de los que susurraban parecía molestarse porque él oyera lo que decían sobre él; al contrario, era como si esperaran que se enfadara y volviera a ponerse a gritar, para poder escuchar su historia de primera mano.

points.sentence: He heard whispers all around him as he sat eating between Ron and Hermione.

messages.content: You are a language tutor. Follow the JSON schema exactly and keep outputs concise and useful for learners.

Analyze each of the following sentences written in en and create a token-level gloss in es for each sentence.

Rules:
- Keep morphemic granularity as close as possible.
- Do not include punctuation marks as tokens.
- Ensure gloss is contextually accurate.
- Ignore verse numbers.
- Return one gloss entry per input sentence, in the same order, inside the "glosses" array.
**Examples:**
1. In Spanish to English, "No lo sé, sin embargo lo pensaré." would be segmented into six tokens: "No" (gloss: "not"), "lo" (gloss: "it"), "sé" (gloss: "know"), " Sin embargo" (gloss: "however"), "lo" (gloss: "it"), "pensaré" (gloss: "will think").
Notice how the comma "," is not included as a separate token, equal case with the final dot "." is not included. And "sin embargo" are treated as one morphemes with the same gloss "however".
2. In Chinese to English, "我喜欢看电视。" would be segmented into four tokens: "我" (pinyin: "wǒ", gloss: "I"), "喜欢" (pinyin: "xǐhuan", gloss: "like"), "看" (pinyin: "kàn", gloss: "watch"), "电视" (pinyin: "diànshì", gloss: "TV").
The punctuation mark "。" is not included as a token. Notice how in the compound word "喜欢", the hanzi "欢" is pronounced with a neutral tone (轻声), so it is written huan instead of huān.

[0] Apple conducts business ethically, honestly, and in full compliance with the law.
[1] We believe that how we conduct ourselves is as critical to Apple’s success as making the best products in the world.
[2] Our Compliance and Business Conduct policies are foundational to how we do business and how we put our values into practice every day.

translations.translatedText: Pasaron diez meses antes de que mi padre descubriera dónde vivía.
Encontró a su viejo amigo sumido en la tristeza, acostado en la cama, incapaz de cualquier actividad.

points.grammar_point: Uso de 'before' como conjunción subordinante para introducir una cláusula de tiempo.
points.sentence: Ten months passed before my father discovered where he lived.
points.explanation: 'Before' se utiliza para indicar que una acción ocurre después de otra en el tiempo. En este caso, 'ten months passed' sucede antes de 'my father discovered where he lived'. La cláusula 'where he lived' es una oración subordinada sustantiva que funciona como complemento directo de 'discovered'.

points.grammar_point: Uso de frases participiales para describir un sustantivo.
points.sentence: He found his old friend sunk in his grief, lying in bed, incapable of any activity.
points.explanation: Las frases 'sunk in his grief', 'lying in bed' y 'incapable of any activity' son construcciones participiales o adjetivales que modifican al sustantivo 'friend'. 'Sunk' es el participio pasado de 'sink', usado como adjetivo. 'Lying' es el participio presente de 'lie', también usado como adjetivo. 'Incapable of any activity' es una frase adjetiva que describe el estado del amigo.

translations.translatedText: En Las Torres Patagonia, una histórica estancia convertida en hotel dentro del parque, 150 caballos recorren libremente 14.800 acres de terreno antes de ser reunidos al amanecer para las cabalgatas de los huéspedes.

Aptas para personas de todos los niveles, estas experiencias aprovechan el poder terapéutico de pasar tiempo con caballos, algo que ha demostrado reducir la ansiedad, mejorar la conciencia emocional y fortalecer la autoestima.

points.sentence: At Las Torres Patagonia, a historic ranch-turned-hotel within the park, 150 horses roam freely across 14,800 acres of land.
points.explanation: “Ranch-turned-hotel” significa “rancho convertido en hotel”. La estructura sustantivo + participio pasado indica que algo se transformó en otra cosa y funciona como adjetivo compuesto.

points.sentence: 150 horses roam freely across 14,800 acres of land before being gathered at dawn for guest rides.
points.explanation: “Being gathered” es la forma pasiva del gerundio: “ser reunidos”. Se usa después de “before” para indicar que los caballos son reunidos antes de otra acción. El sujeto sigue siendo “150 horses”.

translations.translatedText: Llámame Ismael.

Hace algunos años —no importa exactamente cuántos—, con poco o nada de dinero en el bolsillo y sin nada en particular que me interesara en tierra firme, pensé que navegaría un poco para conocer la parte acuática del mundo.

points.grammar_point: Having + participio presente para expresar una circunstancia previa
points.sentence: Having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little.
points.explanation: “Having” introduce una circunstancia que ya se daba antes de la acción principal. Aquí equivale a «como tenía poco o nada de dinero…». La estructura completa funciona como una cláusula participial y comparte el sujeto con “I thought”.

points.sentence: It is a way I have of driving off the spleen, and regulating the circulation.
points.explanation: “A way I have of + gerundio” significa «una manera que tengo de + infinitivo». Los gerundios “driving” y “regulating” describen las acciones que constituyen esa manera. “I have” forma parte de una oración de relativo que modifica “way”.

The punctuation mark "。" is not included as a token. Notice how in the compound word "喜欢", the hanzi "欢" is pronounced with a neutral tone (轻声), so it is written huan instead of huān.

2. In Chinese to English, "我喜欢看电视。" would be segmented into four tokens: "我" (pinyin: "wǒ", gloss: "I"), "喜欢" (pinyin: "xǐhuan", gloss: "like"), "看" (pinyin: "kàn", gloss: "watch"), "电视" (pinyin: "diànshì", gloss: "TV").
The punctuation mark "。" is not included as a token. Notice how in the compound word "喜欢", the hanzi "欢" is pronounced with a neutral tone (轻声), so it is written huan instead of huān.
